Name: Scythe Costs Energy
Author: Sable17
Description:
[size=4]Because sometimes you just want to struggle a little bit more![/size]

[b]Features[/b]
Swinging your [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Scythe]Scythe [/url]now costs [b]2 energy[/b], like other tools.
[spoiler]Swinging your [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Golden_Scythe]Golden Scythe[/url] costs [b]1 energy[/b], and swinging your [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Iridium_Scythe]Iridium Scythe[/url] costs [b]0.5 energy[/b].
[size=1](You'll finally be happy to get the Golden Scythe!)[/size][/spoiler]
The energy cost can be edited in the config.

I am not responsible for any passing-out shenanigans that may occur if someone forgets they have this installed. 

[b]Requirements[/b]
• Stardew Valley 1.6+
• SMAPI

Downloads.Description: Using Scythes cost energy like other tools.
